name: Blossom Bay
blurb: A sunny seaside town where every road ends at the water.

events.name: Rainstorm!
events.blurb: Dark clouds have rolled in over the bay. Buyers are staying indoors, so they won't take much until you leave Blossom Bay.

name: Frostpine Peaks
blurb: A snowy mountain town of warm windows, crunchy paths, and richer customers.

events.name: Blizzard!
events.blurb: A blizzard has swept over the peaks. Each day one spot is snowed in, and you won't know who's trading there until you trudge over.

name: Lantern Crossing
blurb: A busy crossing in the big city, where the lanterns come on as the last trains roll in.

events.name: Fireworks Night!
events.blurb: The summer fireworks are on and the whole city is out. Each night one spot is bustling: more traders, and better prices both ways.
